subject: PO metadata & invoice cadence — ClearWave
messages:
From: Megan Li <megan.li@clearwave.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: ClearWave Procurement <procure@clearwave.com>
Date: 2026-04-14T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: PO metadata & invoice cadence — ClearWave

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to gather a few specifics so we can onboard Redwood cleanly into our AP system. Two quick asks:

1) PO / invoice required fields — our ERP needs the following to auto-match: PO number, billing entity (legal name + tax id), remit address, invoice date, invoice total, contract ID, and cost center. Can you confirm Redwood will expose these fields on each invoice?

2) Net terms & cadence — ClearWave default is net60 and monthly consolidated invoicing. We can consider net45 if needed, but we prefer to avoid weekly invoices. Do you support a single consolidated monthly statement with line-level PO mapping? Also any early-pay discounts you offer would be helpful to know.

I attached our PO schema so you can map fields (ClearWave_PO_Schema.xlsx). Can you send back a Redwood PO template and confirm whether you can accept multiple PO numbers on a single invoice?

If easier, we can hop on a 20-minute call — procurement availability next Thu/Fri.

Best,
Megan Li
Sr. Procurement Manager
ClearWave Health
Attachment: ClearWave_PO_Schema.xlsx (xlsx)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Li <megan.li@clearwave.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-14T12:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO metadata & invoice cadence — ClearWave

Hi Megan — good to connect. Thanks for the schema; looks straightforward. Summary from our side and options below:

Required fields we can include on every invoice (we'll also expose via the invoice PDF and the EDI/CSV payload):
- PO number
- Redwood billing entity and TAX ID
- Remit address (email + physical)
- Invoice date and invoice total
- Contract ID / Deal ID (we'll populate DW-9876)
- Customer cost center / BU code (mapped to your field)

Invoice cadence options we support:
- Monthly consolidated statement (recommended) with a line for each invoice/PO number — matches your request
- Weekly or ad-hoc (available but adds processing overhead)
- Single invoice per PO (if you prefer strict 1:1)

Net terms / early pay:
- Standard enterprise terms: net45 by default for committed deals
- We can extend to net60 for the first 6 months for onboarding if you need runway (w/ milestone review)
- Early-pay discount: finance can offer up to 2% if paid within 10 days (subject to deal size)

Multiple PO numbers on a single consolidated invoice: supported — we'll include PO-level line items so your ERP can auto-apply.

Attachments: I'm attaching our PO template (RW_PO_Template.csv) that shows the exact header fields we populate. If the mapping looks good on your side, I'll loop in Ben (finance) to lock the early-pay % and finalize the invoices-to address.

Next steps:
- Megan: confirm you can accept a monthly consolidated statement to procure@clearwave.com
- We'll send the CSV/EDI spec and a sample invoice to validate mapping
- If needed, schedule a short call — here's a link to book with me: https://cal.com/redwood/karthik-30

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: RW_PO_Template.csv (csv)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Li <megan.li@clearwave.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-04-14T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO metadata & invoice cadence — ClearWave

Megan — quick note from finance to make the options concrete.

1) Default terms: net45 for enterprise contracts (this balances our cash flow with customer needs).
2) Net60: we can permit net60 for the first 6 months as Karthik suggested, provided the deal remains on track and there is a PO/commitment for the period. We'll include a review clause after month 6.
3) Early-pay: we can offer a 2% discount if payment posts within 10 days of invoice date (2% net10). If you need a slightly longer early-pay window (e.g., 15 days), we can consider 1.5% net15.

Operational notes: please ensure PO number is in the invoice header and that your AP team can consume CSV or EDI 810-style payload. For lock-in, our system requires the remit-to email for electronic invoices (ap-invoices@redwood.ai) and the billing entity match to reconcile automatically.

I'll attach our short guide with the discount matrix and reconciliation notes (EarlyPay_Discount_Terms.pdf). Happy to review with your AP lead.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
Attachment: EarlyPay_Discount_Terms.pdf (pdf)

Hi Megan — following up to close the loop from an ops perspective.

Proposal we can operate on immediately:
- Redwood will send a consolidated monthly statement to procure@clearwave.com and ap-invoices@redwood.ai will be our remit endpoint for electronic invoices.
- We will include PO number, billing entity + TAX ID, remit address, invoice date, invoice total, contract ID (DW-9876), and your cost center field on each line.
- Multiple PO numbers per monthly statement: supported. We'll include line-level PO mapping in the CSV and the PDF for your ERP.
- Terms: net60 for the first 6 months, with a review at month 6. Early-pay: 2% if paid within 10 days (2% net10) as an operational option; alternate 1.5% net15 also available if that aligns better with your cycles.

Attached: RW_PO_Template.csv and EarlyPay_Discount_Terms.pdf — these show the payload and the discount matrix. Can you confirm ClearWave can accept the consolidated monthly file and whether we should route the invoice payload to procure@clearwave.com only, or to an AP mailbox (if different)?

If that looks good I suggest we set up a 20-minute validation call with your AP lead next week to run a sample through the mapping. I can host and share a sample invoice.

Thanks all — looking forward to getting procurement onto contract.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
